entities.name: Ad Configuration
entities.description: Feature that gives destination brands granular control over programmatic ad behavior across placements, embeds, platforms, and roll positions, persisted in a database and consumed by the SDK.

entities.name: ad_config.json
entities.description: JSON configuration file storing per-platform (web/android/ios) ad settings such as enabled placements, embeds, frequency, aspect ratio, mute, skip time, and roll toggles.

entities.name: Brand Control Center
entities.description: Admin surface where destination brand admins configure ad settings; the Save click persists settings against the brand in the database.

entities.name: Optimised Monetisation using AI
entities.description: Planned capability where an LLM optimises the engagement and monetisation trade-off for partners and explains setting impacts via conversational interface.

entities.name: LLM Ads
entities.description: Future v3 ad format that surfaces ads inside an LLM conversation triggered when a user clicks the Octo button.

entities.name: Octo Button
entities.description: Entry point that activates the LLM conversation where LLM Ads will be delivered to consumers.

entities.name: MCP
entities.description: Service connected to the LLM that exposes capabilities to read engagement/monetisation analytics and modify ad configuration settings.

entities.name: In-Stream Video Ads
entities.description: Programmatic video ads played within brand content videos; primary v1 scope of the Ad Configuration feature.

entities.name: In-Feed Ads
entities.description: Planned v2 ad format to be added alongside display/native ads after the v1 in-stream rollout.

entities.name: Overlay Ads
entities.description: Display/native overlay ad format planned for a later phase of the Ad Configuration feature.

entities.name: Pre-Roll Ads
entities.description: In-stream ad slot played before the content video, toggled via the in_stream_video_ads_pre_roll field.

entities.name: Mid-Roll Ads
entities.description: In-stream ad slot played during the content video, toggled via the in_stream_video_ads_mid_roll field.

entities.name: End-Roll Ads
entities.description: In-stream ad slot played at the end of the content video, toggled via the in_stream_video_ads_end_roll field.

entities.name: Frequency Capping
entities.description: Logic using ads_free_content_watch_time and ads_free_content_swipes to enforce per-brand swipe and seconds-of-watch-time thresholds before requesting the next in-stream ad.

entities.name: Aspect Ratio Control
entities.description: Setting letting brands either allow all ad aspect ratios or restrict ads to match the player aspect ratio, communicated via the video.boxingallowed macro.

entities.name: Mute On Start
entities.description: Setting that determines whether in-stream ads begin muted, controlling adsManager.setVolume and the bid request video.playbackmethod value.

entities.name: Skippable Ads
entities.description: Setting controlling skip availability and skip offset for in-stream ads via adsRequest.skipOffset and video.skip in bid requests.

entities.name: Ad Duration Display
entities.description: Setting that toggles the countdown UI element in the IMA SDK uiElements array to show remaining ad time on-screen.

entities.name: First In-Stream Ad Video Sequence
entities.description: Configuration controlling the position of the first ad-eligible video in the feed; defaults to the 2nd sequenced video and gates when frequency rules begin to apply.

entities.name: Min Hover Time
entities.description: Minimum hover seconds required for a video play in multi-video setups (carousels/grids) to count toward the ads_free_content_swipes counter.

entities.name: Content Min Duration
entities.description: Minimum content video duration eligible for in-stream ads; if a video is shorter, ad eligibility cascades to the next content video.

entities.name: Max Ad Duration
entities.description: Backend-only configuration capping in-stream ad length, sent to the ad server as video.maxduration in bid requests.

entities.name: Placement-Level Ad Enablement
entities.description: Setting allowing brands to enable in-stream ads only for selected placement IDs listed in in_stream_video_ads_enabled_placements.

entities.name: Embed-Level Ad Enablement
entities.description: Setting allowing brands to enable in-stream ads only for selected embed IDs listed in in_stream_video_ads_enabled_embeds.

entities.name: Full Screen Ads Toggle
entities.description: Setting controlling whether in-stream ads play in full screen mode; always true when in-stream ads are enabled overall.

entities.name: Card View Ads Toggle
entities.description: Setting controlling whether in-stream ads play in card view in addition to full screen.

entities.name: Platform-Specific Ad Settings
entities.description: Capability to configure ad settings independently per platform (web/android/iOS) or globally, reflected in separate keys of ad_config.json.

entities.name: Genuin SDK
entities.description: Web, iOS, and Android SDKs that fetch ad_config.json at initialization, store it in AdPreferences, and enforce ad behavior at runtime.

entities.name: AdPreferences
entities.description: SDK-side store that holds the fetched ad_config.json values used to drive ad request decisions.

entities.name: IMA SDK
entities.description: Google IMA SDK used by the Genuin SDK to generate in-stream ad requests, control ad rendering, preloading, mute volume, skip offset, and UI elements.

entities.name: Aniview
entities.description: Current ad server stack receiving macro parameters and bid request fields such as video.boxingallowed, video.playbackmethod, video.skip, and video.maxduration.

entities.name: Google Ad Manager
entities.description: Planned future ad server migration target replacing the current Aniview-based methodology for ad request and bid parameters.

entities.name: Sprint 40
entities.description: Engineering sprint in which the Ad Configuration feature is scheduled with priority P2.

entities.name: Genuin Network
entities.description: Vision for sponsored content distribution across brand destinations, referenced as out-of-scope future scope tied to Sponsored and Paid Access Monetisation.

entities.name: Sponsored and Paid Access Monetisation
entities.description: Future monetisation track that will activate sponsored content scenarios described in the PRD vision section.

entities.name: Programmatic Ad Revenue
entities.description: Revenue stream generated by serving programmatic in-stream ads within brand video content on destination properties.

entities.name: Destination Brand
entities.description: Retailer or app owner persona that configures ad settings via BCC to enable programmatic revenue while balancing user experience.

entities.name: Partner Brand
entities.description: CPG/sponsor persona that wants to sponsor video experiences on retail destinations to drive measurable sales lift.

entities.name: Creator
entities.description: Creator persona whose branded video content is distributed across retail/commerce apps and monetised through programmatic in-stream ads.

entities.name: Consumer Shopper
entities.description: End user persona expecting relevant, non-intrusive sponsored video experiences inside their shopping journey.

entities.name: Shrushti Shah
entities.description: Design contributor noted as responsible for updating the platform nuances design for handling per-platform ad settings.

entities.name: Shubhangi Singh
entities.description: Design contributor noted alongside Shrushti Shah as responsible for updating the platform nuances design.

relationships.description: The Ad Configuration feature is backed by the ad_config.json file format that stores per-platform ad settings.
Ad Configuration settings are authored by brand admins through the BCC surface and persisted on Save.
BCC writes the brand's chosen settings into the ad_config.json structure persisted in the database.
During initialization the SDK fetches ad_config.json and rewrites existing values in AdPreferences.
The SDK stores the fetched ad configuration inside its AdPreferences component.
The Genuin SDK initializes and drives the Google IMA SDK to generate in-stream ad requests and control rendering.
In-stream ad requests are generated via the IMA SDK when in_stream_video_ads is enabled.
In-stream ad requests are currently fulfilled through the Aniview ad server which receives the bid request parameters.
The PRD notes that current Aniview-based ad server methodology will change upon migration to GAM.
In-stream ads are the v1 scope of the Ad Configuration feature.
In-feed ads are planned for v2 of the Ad Configuration feature.
Display/native overlay ads are planned for a later phase of the Ad Configuration feature.
LLM Ads are planned for v3 of the Ad Configuration feature.
LLM Ads are activated when a user clicks the Octo button to start an LLM conversation.
The LLM-driven optimisation uses an MCP to read analytics and change ad configuration settings.
The MCP exposes capabilities to modify the configurations stored in ad_config.json.
Pre-roll is one of the in-stream ad slots toggled within the Ad Configuration.
Mid-roll is one of the in-stream ad slots toggled within the Ad Configuration.
End-roll is one of the in-stream ad slots toggled within the Ad Configuration.
In-stream ad requests are gated by the swipe and seconds frequency thresholds enforced by the frequency capping logic.
Aspect ratio matching is one of the in-stream ad UX controls in Ad Configuration.
Mute-on-start is one of the in-stream ad UX controls in Ad Configuration.
Skip time is a backend-configured property of in-stream ads governing skip availability.
The duration toggle controls whether remaining ad time is shown for in-stream ads.
The first ad video position governs where in-stream ad eligibility begins in the feed.
Min hover time gates whether a video play counts as a swipe for frequency capping in multi-video layouts.
Content min duration determines whether a content video is eligible for in-stream ads.
Max ad duration is a backend-only setting capping the length of in-stream ads served.
Placement-level enablement restricts in-stream ad requests to specified placement IDs.
Embed-level enablement restricts in-stream ad requests to specified embed IDs.
The full screen toggle controls whether in-stream ads play in full screen mode.
The card view toggle controls whether in-stream ads also play in card view.
Ad Configuration supports per-platform or global settings across web, android, and iOS.
Per-platform settings are stored under the web, android, and ios keys of ad_config.json.
Aniview receives the video.boxingallowed parameter from the IMA SDK to enforce the aspect ratio setting.
The mute-on-start setting drives adsManager.setVolume in the IMA SDK to mute or unmute the ad.
Aniview reads in_stream_video_ads_mute_on_start to set video.playbackmethod in bid requests.
Skip Time is sent to adsRequest.skipOffset on the IMA SDK to enable skippable ads.
Aniview uses in_stream_video_ads_skip_time to set video.skip in the bid request.
Aniview sets video.maxduration in the bid request based on in_stream_video_ads_maxduration.
The duration toggle adds google.ima.UiElements.COUNTDOWN to the IMA SDK uiElements array.
Programmatic ad revenue is generated for destination brands enabling in-stream ads on their properties.
Destination brand admins configure ad settings through the BCC surface.
Destination brand admins drive the Ad Configuration feature to control their ad experience.
Partner brands (CPGs) sponsor video experiences hosted on destination brand properties.
Creator content is distributed across destination brand retail/commerce apps for broader reach.
Consumer shoppers engage with sponsored video experiences hosted on destination brand surfaces.
Sprint 40 scopes delivery of the Ad Configuration feature at priority P2.
The Genuin Network sponsored content vision is gated on activation of Sponsored and Paid Access Monetisation.
Shrushti Shah is assigned to update the design covering platform nuances for per-platform ad settings.
Shubhangi Singh is assigned alongside Shrushti Shah to update the platform nuances design.
